ios.NSCameraUsageDescription: BooKoo needs access to your camera so you can attach a photo to an entry.
ios.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: BooKoo uses Face ID to unlock the app.
ios.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: BooKoo uses your location when you pick a place for an entry or find where you are on the map.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: BooKoo needs permission to save a photo to your photo library.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: BooKoo needs access to your photo library so you can attach a photo to an entry.
